symptom: Mechanism binds mid-stroke; motor stalls at same position every cycle.

probable_causes.cause: transmission angle too small at that crank position
probable_causes.evidence_to_collect: measure crank angle at stall; compute transmission angle
disconnect coupler; check each joint moves freely

procedures: 2. disconnect coupler pins one at a time to isolate the stiff joint
4. if binding is positional, redesign link ratio (agent can recompute Grashof + angles)
verification: full rotation by hand without stall; motor current flat over cycle
safety_notes: store energy in mechanism may snap when freed
